title: Transport Infrastructure, Network & Operations | Vidhi
description: Explore Vidhi Transport's branch network, vehicle planning, handling coordination, live LR support and industrial logistics capabilities in Gujarat and Maharashtra.

hero.title: Infrastructure is the system behind every dispatch.
hero.subtitle: Plan from the real operating requirement.
intro: Branches, vehicle planning, handling interfaces, documentation and shipment visibility work together to support industrial movement across Gujarat and Maharashtra.
Capability is matched to the cargo, route, site, timing and handling requirement, with availability confirmed for each shipment.
list: Vehicle and route matched to the actual cargo
Loading, handling and site responsibilities agreed early
Branch contacts and live LR support kept accessible

sections.title: Practical capability across the freight journey.
intro: Vidhi brings branch coordination, cargo handling, route planning and shipment visibility into one operating network. Shipment-specific vehicle, space and handling requirements are confirmed by the responsible operations team.
Direct branch details and service-area context across key Gujarat and Maharashtra industrial regions.
From PTL and FTL to project cargo, port containers, reverse logistics and warehousing.
The tracking page requests the latest available shipment record directly from the Vidhi ERP service.

sections.title: The equipment follows the requirement.
intro: No vehicle type is assumed from a service label alone. Dimensions, weight, packaging, classification, route, body requirement, access and timing determine what can be considered.

cards.title: FTL vehicle planning
body: Dedicated capacity for accepted larger, scheduled and direct industrial dispatches.
list: Vehicle selected around cargo and route

cards.title: PTL network movement
body: Consolidated transport for accepted smaller consignments moving through operating corridors.

cards.title: Project and ODC review
body: Requirement-led planning for machinery, equipment and cargo that needs technical movement coordination.

cards.title: Containers and warehousing
body: Port-linked container movements and practical staging or distribution support where available.

sections.title: Four interfaces that shape execution.
intro: Good road freight depends on clear responsibility at every handoff. These controls help the branch, vehicle, shipper and consignee work from the same operating brief.

cards.title: Documentation
body: Align the cargo description, package data, route, transport documents and applicable regulatory information before dispatch.

cards.title: Loading interface
body: Confirm dock, forklift, crane, rigging, labour, loading window and who is responsible at origin.

cards.title: Movement control
body: Coordinate the accepted route, contacts, vehicle requirement and exception communication through the responsible team.

cards.title: Delivery interface
body: Confirm receiving hours, access, unloading support, delivery terms and authorised consignee contact.

sections.title: Use the network, tracking and storage pages.
intro: Each supporting page provides more useful detail than a broad infrastructure claim and creates a clear next step for the customer.

cards.title: Branch network
body: View published addresses, direct numbers, capabilities and nearby service areas for each listed location.

cards.title: Live LR tracking
body: Enter a numeric LR number to request route, dates and the latest available ERP status record.

cards.title: Warehousing support
body: Review storage, inward, staging, consolidation and outward distribution support, subject to facility approval.

faqs.q: How is a vehicle selected for a shipment?
faqs.a: Vehicle planning depends on the cargo, route, timing, body type, capacity, access and availability confirmed for the actual requirement.

faqs.q: Which vehicle types can be considered?
faqs.a: Depending on feasibility and availability, enquiries may involve vehicles for PTL or FTL, container-linked movements, machinery, project cargo or over-dimensional requirements. Exact equipment is confirmed only after technical review.
No. Forklift, crane, rigging, dock, labour and loading or unloading responsibilities must be stated and agreed before booking. Availability varies by location and operating scope.

faqs.q: How does the branch network support movement?
faqs.a: Published branches provide local contact and coordination across Gujarat and Maharashtra industrial corridors. Actual route, service, pickup and delivery availability remain subject to confirmation.
